title: Proof of Election: A Formally-Verified Democratic Blockchain Protocol
venue: IEEE International Conference on Decentralized Applications and Infrastructures
note: Alphabetical author order with Amir Goharshady.
abstract: We present Proof-of-Election, a new blockchain consensus protocol that mimics real-world democratic elections, to vote based on block contents rather than blindly trust proposers, and only admit the highest voted block in each slot.
